correctStatements.text: At 18:45 s.kowalczyk saw inference requests queueing with p95 latency at 14 seconds.
Mateo found the autoscaler wanted 8 more GPU nodes but the cloud returned quota exceeded.
yuki-tanaka said the quota of 24 GPUs per region was fully used in europe-west.
At 18:57 s.kowalczyk shifted 30% of traffic to the us-east cluster.
At 19:02 Mateo requested an emergency quota increase to 40.
At 19:09 s.kowalczyk saw p95 fall to 5 seconds after the shift.
At 19:21 inference-capacity-planning-wg-lead-account said cloud support approved 36 GPUs rather than the 40 requested.
At 19:27 Mateo saw new nodes joining the pool.
At 19:35 s.kowalczyk shifted traffic back to europe-west and p95 was 1.9 seconds.
inference-capacity-planning-wg-lead-account noted about 50 minutes of degraded latency in total.
Action item: alert at 80% of GPU quota in each region, owner yuki-tanaka.
Action item: review quota headroom every month, owner Mateo.
